name: Universal Garbage Station
storyline:
In the future, while technological advancements bring convenience to people’s lives, they also create a troubling issue: a massive amount of unmanageable waste. Whether through incineration or burial, it seems impossible to completely and harmlessly dispose of all kinds of garbage.
At this time, a company named GPOINT emerges out of nowhere.
GPOINT offers a revolutionary waste disposal solution—whether it’s household waste, kitchen scraps, or even nuclear waste, as long as it’s labeled “garbage,” GPOINT can handle it perfectly.
Of course, such miraculous technology is a closely guarded trade secret, and no one knows how they manage to process such vast amounts of waste.​
summary: Universal Garbage Station is a body-horror-centric hgame, set in the lower levels of a dystopian corporate headquarters. You play as an otaku tasked with the creation (and subsequent destruction) of vaguely humanoid sex toys.
